verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents 15+ official SDK languages (TypeScript, .NET, Java) with React and Next.js integrations, and says it manages flags across web, mobile, and server-side apps. It also distinguishes client-side from server-side SDKs and connects server-side SDKs to its self-hosted Edge Proxy, which runs the Flagsmith Engine. Missing for 10: named mobile SDKs (e.g. iOS/Android/Flutter), explicit documentation of consistent evaluation behavior across SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-stack SDK parity.
